keys.name: SUPABASE_URL
keys.description: Supabase project URL for messaging worker

keys.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
keys.description: Supabase service-role key for worker RPCs

keys.name: WORKER_TICK_SECRET
keys.description: Shared secret for worker tick auth (auto-generated on sync if empty)

keys.name: WORKER_ENV
keys.description: Environment for the messaging worker (e.g., production, staging, development)

keys.name: WORKER_TENANT_BATCH_SIZE
keys.description: Max tenants processed per worker tick

keys.name: WORKER_MODULE_BATCH_SIZE
keys.description: Max modules processed per tenant batch

keys.name: WORKER_MAX_ROUNDS_PER_TICK
keys.description: Max processing rounds inside one worker tick

keys.name: WORKER_CONCURRENCY
keys.description: Max partition groups processed in parallel per tick

keys.name: WORKER_TICK_ACTIVE_SECONDS
keys.description: Sleep seconds between ticks while work remains

keys.name: WORKER_TICK_IDLE_SECONDS
keys.description: Sleep seconds when no work was found

keys.name: WORKER_TICK_MAX_IDLE_SECONDS
keys.description: Upper bound for idle backoff between ticks

keys.name: PORT
keys.description: HTTP listen port for worker health/serve

keys.name: RESEND_API_KEY
keys.description: API key for Resend email service

keys.name: RESEND_FROM_DOMAIN
keys.description: Domain used as sender for Resend email service

keys.name: APP_LINK_BASE_URL
keys.description: Base URL used for generating application links

once.description: Run one worker tick then exit

docker.description: Docker Compose up messaging-worker (image tagged by env)
